page.layout: One page of text, centred; no margin notes. Top: dedication heading lines; below: signature line; bottom: signature mark and catchword-like header "AD LEC-" at foot right.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo, Amplissimoque VIRO D. DANIELI HEINSIO, EQUITI S. MARCI, INTER CELEBERRIMOS ACADEMIÆ LUGDUNO-BATAVÆ Professores eminentissimo, Bibliothecario, ejusdemque Athenæi Secretario, viro vere incomparabili, singularique reip. literariæ ornamento,

page.notes: The top line is a rough, italic heading with a decorative "V I R O" spaced line; the lower "AD LEC-" is printed at the foot right and is the start of the next page's heading, so it is given as catchword. Page number printed as "* 2" with an asterisk and the numeral 2 at the foot left of centre.
